messages.content: Predict this human participant's complete conditional contribution strategy in a one-shot sequential public goods game. There are five members: one first-mover and four followers, including you. Each is independently endowed with20 or80 Monetary Units(MU),each with50%probability;1MU=US$0.01. You know your own and the first-mover's endowments. You can keep money privately or contribute any integer amount from0 to your own endowment. The sum of all five contributions is doubled and divided equally among all five,regardless of who contributed. Your game bonus equals your own endowment minus your contribution plus two fifths of all five contributions. A fixed participation fee is additional. You are a follower. Responses are collected separately and people are grouped afterwards;there is no deception and choices have real financial consequences. On the current page you are asked for two contingent amounts:if the first-mover contributes their entire endowment,and if the first-mover contributes0MU. Only the scenario corresponding to your subsequently matched first-mover's actual choice determines payment. This is one strategy with two entries,not two successive played rounds. No other follower's current contribution or realized payoff is given. The two questions are displayed on the same page with randomized question order;no individual order is asserted here. Personal information supplied describes your own prior background;original English profile text is retained. Output only a JSON object serialized as text,with exactly the integer fields if_firstmover_full_MU and if_firstmover_zero_MU. Each value must be between0 and your endowment inclusive. Give no explanation.
